tables.name: app.account_deletion_requests
tables.comment: Account deletion state machine: requested (cooling-off, cancellable), executed or canceled; the record is retained as evidence after execution

columns.name: executed_at
columns.comment: Instant the anonymization executed; after it the account can never authenticate again

columns.name: cancel_reason
columns.comment: Holder-provided cancellation reason; restricted evidence, never part of a public projection

constraints.name: account_deletion_requests_account_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (account_id) REFERENCES app.accounts(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: account_deletion_requests_canceled_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (status <> 'canceled'::text OR canceled_at IS NOT NULL AND canceled_at >= requested_at AND executed_at IS NULL AND cancel_reason IS NOT NULL AND btrim(cancel_reason) <> ''::text AND char_length(cancel_reason) <= 500)

constraints.name: account_deletion_requests_executed_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (status <> 'executed'::text OR executed_at IS NOT NULL AND executed_at >= requested_at AND canceled_at IS NULL AND cancel_reason IS NULL)

constraints.name: account_deletion_requests_requested_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (status <> 'requested'::text OR executed_at IS NULL AND canceled_at IS NULL AND cancel_reason IS NULL)

indexes.name: account_deletion_requests_active_unique
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX account_deletion_requests_active_unique ON app.account_deletion_requests USING btree (account_id) WHERE (status = 'requested'::text)

indexes.name: account_deletion_requests_due_idx

indexes.name: account_deletion_requests_pkey

columns.name: relation
columns.comment: Declared relation to the Arena statement: support, oppose or context

columns.name: content
columns.comment: Plaintext content as published; never edited after publication

columns.name: content_hash
columns.comment: Versioned canonical hash of the content (format owned by the domain)

columns.name: grapheme_cost
columns.comment: Grapheme cluster count: the 1 INK per cluster billing unit, at most 3000

columns.name: status

columns.name: idempotency_key

tables.comment: Append-only administrative audit trail: one immutable row per administrative fact, readable by support and auditors, never rewritten

columns.name: action
columns.comment: Namespaced stable operation code (module.operation); greppable across wallet, moderation, billing and admin sources

columns.name: target_type
columns.comment: Closed target vocabulary; the identifier lives in target_id

columns.name: reason_code
columns.comment: Stable reason or rule code; free prose never enters this column

columns.name: metadata
columns.comment: Minimal allowlisted JSONB object (identifiers, references, transitions); payloads, secrets and PII are unrepresentable

columns.name: idempotency_key
columns.comment: Caller-chosen retry key, unique when set; NULL records unconditionally

columns.name: correlation_id
columns.comment: Optional opaque correlation grouping related events recorded together

constraints.name: audit_events_actor_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (actor_id) REFERENCES app.accounts(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: audit_events_correlation_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (correlation_id IS NULL OR btrim(correlation_id) <> ''::text AND char_length(correlation_id) <= 200)

constraints.name: audit_events_idempotency_key_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (idempotency_key IS NULL OR btrim(idempotency_key) <> ''::text AND char_length(idempotency_key) <= 200)

constraints.name: audit_events_metadata_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (metadata IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(metadata) = 'object'::text AND (metadata - ARRAY['operation_id'::text, 'reference'::text, 'idempotency_key'::text, 'arena_id'::text, 'argument_id'::text, 'attribution_id'::text, 'target_account_id'::text, 'case_id'::text, 'action_id'::text, 'appeal_id'::text, 'intent_id'::text, 'subscription_id'::text, 'previous_status'::text, 'new_status'::text, 'outcome'::text, 'replayed'::text, 'rule'::text, 'reason'::text]) = '{}'::jsonb AND octet_length(metadata::text) <= 2048)

indexes.name: audit_events_actor_idx

indexes.name: audit_events_correlation_idx

tables.name: app.jobs
tables.comment: Durable job queue: one row per unit of work, leased with SKIP LOCKED and recoverable after a crashed holder

columns.name: type
columns.comment: Closed workload vocabulary; handlers per type arrive with the worker

columns.name: version
columns.comment: Schema version of the payload; a bump is an explicit, reviewable change

columns.name: parameters
columns.comment: Bounded JSON object with identifiers, references and arguments (the job payload); rendered output, credentials and free prose are unrepresentable

columns.name: idempotency_key
columns.comment: Caller-chosen retry key, unique when set; NULL enqueues unconditionally

columns.name: state
columns.comment: Lifecycle: queued, leased, succeeded or dead

columns.name: available_at
columns.comment: Earliest instant the job may run (also the retry instant after a failure)

columns.name: attempts
columns.comment: Attempts already consumed; bounded by max_attempts

columns.name: lease_owner
columns.comment: Worker that holds the lease; NULL for every non-leased row

columns.name: leased_until
columns.comment: Instant the lease expires and the job becomes claimable again

columns.name: last_error_code
columns.comment: Stable redacted code (JOB_*) of the last failure; never a provider message

columns.name: last_error_detail
columns.comment: Bounded, already-sanitized failure detail; never a stack trace or payload echo

constraints.name: jobs_idempotency_key_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (idempotency_key IS NULL OR btrim(idempotency_key) <> ''::text AND char_length(idempotency_key) <= 200)

constraints.name: jobs_last_error_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((last_error_code IS NULL) = (last_error_detail IS NULL) AND (last_error_code IS NULL OR last_error_code ~ '^JOB_[A-Z0-9_]{2,61}$'::text AND char_length(last_error_detail) <= 300))

constraints.name: jobs_lease_coherence_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((state = 'leased'::text) = (lease_owner IS NOT NULL AND leased_until IS NOT NULL))

constraints.name: jobs_lease_owner_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (lease_owner IS NULL OR btrim(lease_owner) <> ''::text AND char_length(lease_owner) <= 128)

constraints.name: jobs_terminal_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((state <> ALL (ARRAY['succeeded'::text, 'dead'::text])) OR lease_owner IS NULL AND leased_until IS NULL)

indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX jobs_claimable_idx ON app.jobs USING btree (available_at, id) WHERE (state = 'queued'::text)

indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX jobs_idempotency_unique ON app.jobs USING btree (idempotency_key)
